questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **benevolent**.
questions.explanation: Benevolent means kindly and wishing to do good.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to **ancient**.
questions.explanation: Ancient means very old; modern is its opposite.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **reluctant**.
One word for "a person who loves books":
questions.explanation: A philatelist collects stamps; a misanthrope dislikes people.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to **victory**.
questions.explanation: The other three are near synonyms of victory.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **vital**.
One word for "government by the people":
questions.explanation: Autocracy is rule by one person; aristocracy by a noble class.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **conceal**.
questions.explanation: To conceal is to keep out of sight.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to **temporary**.
questions.explanation: The other three mean lasting a short time.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **hostile**.
questions.explanation: Hostile means showing opposition or dislike.

questions.question: One word for "an extreme fear of heights":
questions.explanation: Claustrophobia is fear of enclosed spaces; hydrophobia of water; xenophobia of strangers.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **brief**.
questions.explanation: Brief means lasting or taking a short time.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to **increase**.
questions.explanation: To decrease is to become less.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to **prompt**.
questions.explanation: A prompt reply is made without delay.

questions.question: One word for "a place where birds are kept":
questions.explanation: An apiary is for bees; an aquarium is for fish.
